fee_notes: Royalty tiered: 5.5% of gross revenue up to $1M/year, 3% above $1M. Quarterly royalty minimum $7,500. Marketing Fund (CMF) 2% of gross revenue, monthly minimum $621, maximum $1,728 per office (as of Jan 1, 2026). Additional fees: transfer $5,000, liquidated damages on early termination (36× or remaining term monthly fees), audit $450+/day minimum, late interest at prime+2%.
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fees: 5.5% of aggregate Gross Revenue up to $1,000,000 per calendar year; 3% in excess of $1,000,000. Minimum Standard Fees: If quarterly royalties <$7,500, difference due. Commercial Marketing Fund (CMF): 2% of Gross Revenue monthly with minimum $621 and maximum $1,728 per office.
